topic: Repair kit essentials for remote routes

content.hook: 3 fixes your repair kit must cover

slides.title: *3 fixes* your repair kit must cover
slides.body: Flats, chain, loose bolts. Pack for all three.

slides.title: Pack the *basics*
slides.body: Spare tube, patches, tyre levers, pump, quick link, multi-tool. Test them at home.

slides.title: Know the *nearest* repair
slides.body: Check where bike repair is nearby before you leave.

content.caption:
Bikepacking repair kit essentials for remote routes: 3 fixes to cover.

Flats. Chain trouble. Loose bolts.

Pack a spare tube, patches, tyre levers, a pump, a quick link and a multi-tool. Then practise with them at home. A repair is much easier in your living room than on a gravel track.

A kit only gets you so far. Know where the nearest bike repair is before you roll out.

What's the one repair item you never leave without?

Plan your next trip at bikepackpilot.com (link in bio).

issues: CTA slide title 'Plan your repair stops in minutes' blends two approved claims. The 'in minutes' claim is about planning a route, not repair stops. Reworded to match the approved fact 'Find water, food, bike repair and lodging nearby'.
Everything else checks out: structure, word limits, caption length, question on its own line, exact CTA, hashtags, clip match, safe general advice.
Slide 3 body and CTA title imply the app searches 'along/near your route'; approved fact is only 'find bike repair nearby'. Reworded to stay within approved claims.
#cyclingtouring is a weak/rarely used tag; replaced with #bicycletouring, which is more commonly used in this niche.
